instruction: Tell me the card name I used for my last amazon prime membership payment?
notes: Read-only information task: no database changes are allowed, so all actions are lookups plus login. Static init facts (last-subscription, paid-with, card-named) encode that the latest prime subscription and its card exist in the database; knowledge predicates (found-last-subscription, known-id, found-card-name, answer-known) track what the agent has discovered. show_prime_subscriptions reveals the payment_card_id of the latest subscription, show_payment_card resolves it to a card_name, and complete_task passes that card name as the answer. Login username is the supervisor's email.
